title: Reposilite 3.5.27 before 3.6.7 contains a brute-force protection bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated…
description: Reposilite versions from 3.5.27 up to but not including 3.6.7 contain a vulnerability that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass brute-force protection by spoofing the X-Forwarded-For header. This enables attackers to evade login bans, perform unlimited password or token guessing attempts, or forge failed attempts to lock out legitimate users.
